prep.summary: Address the workload equity crisis with Mike—who agreed that you, Justin, and James must proactively reallocate tasks following seven team departures over 18 months. Prioritize protecting high performers—specifically Vince—from burnout by establishing clear, principle-based rebalancing guidelines. Establish these workload rules during your session—ensuring standard architecture governance survives persistent resourcing constraints.

Align with Mike on mitigation plans for the Informatica retirement targeted for August 2027.
Address the bypass of standard architectural pathways by staff engineers on the Ernix and Snowflake platforms.
Resolve the outstanding security waiver and IAM concerns regarding the unauthenticated Stellantis OEM flow scaling.

prep.summary: You must track the $7,000,000 platform budget split—specifically across Claims, DNS, and TVO—while addressing the critical governance gaps in P&C shadow architecture. Transitioning to capability-based mapping—coupled with the integration of the "Permit to Design" frameworks—remains a key priority under RV's new leadership. Resolving these alignment issues will require strict enforcement of tech acquisition pathways before final procurement execution.
tasks: Resolve the Informatica retirement bottlenecks—specifically the Python performance issues on legacy pipelines—prior to the August 2027 conversion target.
Rebalance the team workload disparities—especially for high performers like Vince—to prevent burnout following recent staff attrition.
Finalize the Technology Acquisition Process framework to establish a unified routine for Dan's Friday review meetings.
Establish a time-boxed consulting model for the 90-day execution pods to mitigate severe resource constraints in P&C architecture.

prep.summary: You must reject the mandated JWM assignments—the team has agreed to stop manual logging and forced personal task tracking. Address the process intelligence prep for Wednesday's BOD by leveraging the current Celonis initiative—specifically the mapping of 25 workflows over 90 days—to demonstrate rapid execution. Review Jennifer's draft of the simplified technology acquisition process—a critical one-pager designed to engage architecture early and relieve the capacity pressures of onboarding high volumes of third-party tech.
tasks: Terminate mandated JWM tracking—rely instead on tools fit for purpose to eliminate administrative waste.
Prepare the Wednesday BOD presentation using the Celonis 90-day mapping timeline—focus on the 25 target experiences in Claims.
Review Jennifer's simplified tech acquisition one-pager—ensure it establishes clear risk-based guardrails and 'permit to operate' standards.
Align architect resourcing with the high volume of third-party tech acquisitions—prevent unaligned proposals from bypassing governance.
